Resilience, Not Reach, is Banking’s New Hard Limit
summary:
Universal banks are trying to move faster without first becoming simpler, and AI will not fix that. Elixirr partner Tej Patel on complexity as risk.
The post Resilience, Not Reach, is Banking’s New Hard Limit appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Universal banks are currently prioritizing resilience over traditional reach as their primary operating limit. According to Elixirr partner Tej Patel, these financial institutions are attempting to accelerate their operations without first addressing underlying organizational complexity. Furthermore, the implementation of artificial intelligence will not automatically resolve these deep-rooted structural challenges, highlighting complexity itself as a major risk in the banking sector.

summary:

content: Central banks worldwide are increasingly withdrawing their gold reserves from the New York Federal Reserve.
